translation:
Hey, Nagato, I haven't erased everything
yet, but it still reverted to the original space.
Okay, I'm back. Does that mean it's settled?
The opponent's main body escaped.

What a mess… If we had erased it just a bit
sooner it might not have gotten away.
You are not at fault. Do not worry.
No, but isn't this a bad thing?
Next time, I will not let them escape.

At a glance, she's the same as ever. However,
something feels different about her.
Perhaps she's frustrated with this result.
Kyon!
Asahina…
Thank goodness you're safe!
I'm glad to see you're unharmed.
You seem to know what's going on here.
Yes, that's correct.

In the end, everyone's here except for
Haruhi. This is about her, right?

It started with Miss Asahina noticing that you
had disappeared.

You suddenly vanished before my eyes. I was
really frightened…
Just what happened, exactly?

You completely lose me when you bring up
"spaces” and "phases” and the like.

As you may be aware, it gives off a feeling
similar to closed space…

Closed space? The thing Haruhi generates
when her pent-up stress overflows, like that?

So, she really is the cause of this mess after
all?

The closed space originating from Haruhi
Suzumiya is similar, but not the same.

That seems to be the case. Now then, what
would be a good way to explain this…?

Please try to make your explanation as
digestible as possible.

It's an outbreak of space cut off from our
current plane.

Perhaps it would be best to describe it as
"alternate space.”

Furthermore, according to Miss Nagato, it
seems to exist everywhere in this school.
Huh…?

The space you wandered into was just about
to reach a stabilized state.

That's unexpected… so then I was in a life or
death situation?
Regrettably, the crisis is still ongoing.

Even at this very moment, more alternate
space is breaking out within the school.

When and where more classrooms will start
popping up is entirely uncertain, I'm afraid.
Ah, so that's what I was experiencing…

Nagato, can't you do something about it with
your abilities?
Possible. But not recommended.
Why do you say that?

Currently, the data links upholding the school
space are losing stability.

Forced erasure could potentially generate
distortions in the surrounding space.
To put it simply:

Abruptly damming the flow of a river could be
disastrous to the surrounding environment.
Wouldn't you agree?

It's better to have Koizumi translate it into
layman's terms after all.
But then, what should we do…?

There sure doesn't seem to be an easy
answer, so what would be our best bet?

Identify the source of the space and
eliminate it.
It will then fade away naturally.

So we should take the same approach as with
that last alternate space?
Correct.

In that case, we'd better act quickly. There's
no time to waste.
You're right, we should probably start now.
That is impossible.

Hey, but isn't it a bad idea to leave them
alone?!

Pinpointing the data lifeform that appears to
be generating alternate space is difficult.
It may currently be in motion.

I felt the dejection of a sumo wrestler thrown
out of the ring after his attack was parried.

It will take some more time to identify the
precise location.
Well, then I'll leave that up to you, Nagato.
Understood.

In that case, there's only one thing we can
do.
And what would that be?

We must do what we can to keep Miss Suzumiya
away from the school.

To make Miss Nagato's job easier, as well as
help to prevent the worst-case scenario.
Worst-case scenario?

If Miss Suzumiya witnesses this abnormal
situation, there may be grave consequences.
She'd probably be overjoyed.
I'm afraid that's not the point.

If Miss Suzumiya observes alternate space,
she will come to believe that it truly exists.

A world in which alternate space exists
everywhere could become reality.
The very definition of a global crisis.

I couldn't brush off what Koizumi said as a
mere exaggeration.

A world where glowing giants rampage
freely—a world where nobody else exists—
I've seen all of that before with my own eyes.

The last thing I want is another confusing
world like that getting mass-produced.

But Suzumiya, she's very enthusiastic about
searching for unnatural phenomena…

There are several ways to keep Miss
Suzumiya away from the school.

For example, arranging for something else
that might capture her interest.

Alternatively, making her fundamentally lose
interest in this particular phenomenon.
Lose interest, huh…?

Either way, we are sorely lacking in
information.

It may be helpful to listen to more of what the
computer society members have to say.
That's true…

I think we should split into two groups. One to
distract Haruhi, and the other to gather info.
This is quite a troublesome matter, isn't it?

We'll also need an excuse for being short on
members when we meet back up with Haruhi.

About that, it may be fine to honestly say we
went back to interview the witnesses more.
So then, how should we do this?
About Haruhi
